proposal: The Mandate recommends RCRA changes: create a post-closure care permit tailored to post-closure obligations, modify regulations that impede recycling and reuse by providing an alternative pathway to hazardous waste regulation for transport to legitimate recyclers, move the e-Manifest system to 100 percent electronic and eliminate paper manifests, reassign RCRA air emission standards to the air office, and restructure the Office of Land and Emergency Management, including eliminating the Office of Emergency Management and moving the emergency management function into the homeland security function under the Administrator's office, moving removal authority into the Superfund remediation office and dropping Emergency Management from the office name (pp. 432-433).

status_summary: On 2026-03-05 EPA proposed a Paper Manifest Sunset Rule (91 FR 10862) that would stop accepting paper hazardous waste manifests 24 months after a final rule is published, with comments due 2026-05-04; a Federal Register search on 2026-10-18 found no final rule. On 2026-03-23 EPA proposed a categorical non-waste determination under its non-hazardous secondary materials rules for recovered abandoned scrap tires burned as fuel in cement kilns, a narrow change related to the recycling recommendation. EPA announced updates to the Office of Land and Emergency Management on 2025-07-17 without structural details, and no post-closure permit rule, hazardous waste recycling pathway, air standards reassignment or elimination of the emergency management office was found.

timeline.event: EPA announced a next phase of organizational improvements that included updates to the Office of Land and Emergency Management; the release gave no structural details.
EPA proposed the Paper Manifest Sunset Rule, ending acceptance of paper hazardous waste manifests 24 months after a final rule (91 FR 10862).

EPA proposed a categorical non-waste determination under 40 CFR part 241 for recovered abandoned scrap tires burned in cement kilns and a revised definition of established tire collection program (91 FR 13804; comments due 2026-05-22).

title: RCRA reforms: recycling, post-closure permit, all-electronic manifests, OLEM changes
uncertainties: The paper manifest proposal's summary, dates and preamble were read in review; the closing regulatory text was read in research only. The Federal Register page metadata lists 2026-04-06 as the comment close, which is the date for comments to OMB on information collection; the proposal's own dates section sets 2026-05-04. A trade press headline dated 2025-10-29 reports a planned November 2025 merger of Superfund, emergency management and federal facilities units into an Office of Superfund and Emergency Management; only the paywalled excerpt was read, so it is not in the timeline and its status is unconfirmed. Searches run: Federal Register API (definition of solid waste, e-Manifest, post-closure, paper manifest), and web searches on RCRA recycling and OLEM reorganization. A broader recycling rule query was rejected for length, so a general recycling or definition of solid waste proposal could be missed. Information collection renewals for the existing solid waste definition rule (2025-12-11 and 2026-06-22) are not reform actions.
